description: Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique. Coverage: Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Barrières inondation; Repères de crues du Gard; Crues historiques et arrêtés de catastrophes naturelles sur le Gard; Zone inondable du Gard (zone inondable de référence 2013+atlas hydrogé. Formats seen: HTML, CSV, TXT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
